general.singleCityNotice: Toulouse Métropole is the only city with a live data connector today. Use the city selector in the header to preview the other OneAquaHealth consortium cities the platform is already built to onboard.

aiProvider.apiKeyHint: Write-only. Leave blank to keep the currently stored key.

riskEngine.description: Deterministic risk engine weights and severity thresholds. The score is a weighted combination of the 4 factors below (weights are renormalized when a factor has no data yet); the score is then bucketed into LOW/MODERATE/HIGH/CRITICAL using the 3 thresholds.

tooltips.weightsRainfall: Share of the score driven by 24h cumulative precipitation. Normalized against a 40mm/24h reference (documented fallback — official Vigicrues thresholds were not available at build time).
tooltips.weightsHydrology: Share of the score driven by the current Garonne water level, placed on a 0–1 scale using the station's own observed min/max over the last 90 days (relative fallback until official flood thresholds are available).
tooltips.weightsEnvironmental: Share of the score driven by soil moisture (already expressed 0–1 by Open-Meteo).
tooltips.weightsTrend: Share of the score driven by how fast the water level is rising over the trailing 6h, normalized against a 50mm/h reference. A falling or flat level never adds risk.
tooltips.thresholdsLow: Score at or above this value is at least MODERATE (below it, LOW).
tooltips.thresholdsModerate: Score at or above this value is at least HIGH.
tooltips.thresholdsHigh: Score at or above this value is CRITICAL.

usersAccess.matrixHint: Grant module × permission access per role.
usersAccess.cannotDeleteSelf: You cannot delete your own account.
usersAccess.userPermissionsHint: Editing a checkbox here creates a permission set specific to this user, cloned from their current role — it never changes the shared role itself, so no one else on that role is affected.

map.description: Choose the default free, open tile provider for the Resilience Map. No account or API key is needed for any of these. Individual users can still pick a different base map for themselves from the map's own layer picker — this only sets what they see before they do.
map.defaultViewHint: The map centers here on load. Comes from the configured city's own reference data — to change it, add or edit a city rather than typing coordinates here.
map.riskLayerOpacityHint: Opacity (0-100) of the risk-level halo shown around the river gauge station on the map. Set to 0 to hide it.

alerts.description: Early Warnings follow a fixed 3-step lifecycle — nothing here is user-configurable (severity thresholds that open a warning are set in Risk Engine above).

lifecycle.active: Created automatically the moment the risk score reaches MODERATE or above.
lifecycle.acknowledged: An Operator or Administrator has seen it and is on it — set from the Early Warnings page.
lifecycle.resolved: Automatically, once the score drops back to LOW — or manually, at any point, by an Operator or Administrator.

system.maintenanceModeHint: When enabled, only Administrators can make changes anywhere in the platform (creating, editing, acknowledging, running a scenario, etc.) — everyone else gets a clear read-only message. Viewing data, logging in and infra healthchecks are never affected. Use this before a risky change (e.g. restoring a backup) so no one else writes data mid-operation.
